what: a diamond hoe: a big flat blade, about a third of the canvas wide, set at a right angle across the top of the shaft and reading clearly at slot size, made of faceted cyan diamond with teal shadows, white facet tips and one small sparkle, a gold collar, on a handle wrapped in red-brown leather with gold bands and a round gold pommel, lying diagonally, handle at the bottom left, tip at the top right, filling the canvas corner to corner
